name: NURS 3205
title: Nursing Research and Evidence-Based Practice
description: An introduction to qualitative and quantitative research and application to evidence-based nursing practice.  Focus placed on developing the ability to understand, interpret, critically appraise, and apply research for high value nursing practice.
requirement_description: STAT 1000Q or 1100Q, and ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011.
